title: Ping-pong loop of the leads chart
caption: A 2.6 s moment from the motion promo, where the leads chart opens and its bars grow, turned into a seamless ping-pong loop: it plays forward, then backward, so the last frame flows straight back into the first with no jump.
prompt: Take the leads chart moment from ../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4 (6.9 s to 9.5 s, where the pill opens into the chart card and the bars grow) and turn it into a seamless loop for a website hero background and a looping social post. Use a forward-then-reverse ping-pong so there is no jump at the seam, with no repeated frame at either turn.
credits: Video: 06-motion-graphics from this showcase (Geist and Geist Mono fonts by Vercel, SIL OFL 1.1; motion engine adapted from Barty-Bart/motion-graphics, MIT)
